description: Separate receipt language core (design §5.1, §5.2, §5.3 posReceiptData module, §5.4 taxInvoiceHtml module, §7 payment pure helpers, §10 tests). Adds receiptLanguage to the persisted receipt config with v3 migration, receipt-language label helpers in receiptTemplate.ts, pure posReceiptData.ts and taxInvoiceHtml.ts (not yet wired into screens — FEAT-004/005 do that), useReceiptT hook, memberTypeDiscountLabel/cartAdapter lang param. Depends on FEAT-001. Plan item 2.
steps: src/store/receiptStore.ts: import type Language + isLanguage from src/i18n/types and DEFAULT_FOOTER_TH/DEFAULT_BRANCH_TH from src/i18n/labels; add required `receiptLanguage: Language` to ReceiptConfig; DEFAULT gets receiptLanguage 'th', footerText DEFAULT_FOOTER_TH, shopBranch DEFAULT_BRANCH_TH (values unchanged); persist version 2 -> 3 with the chained migrate from design §5.1 (identity pass-through when fromVersion >= 3 or no config); merge normalizes receiptLanguage (garbage -> 'th'). Fix any other ReceiptConfig literals tsc flags.

Create src/i18n/useReceiptT.ts: useReceiptT() subscribes useReceiptStore(s => s.config.receiptLanguage ?? 'th') and returns { rt: (k: ReceiptKey, p?) => string, receiptLang, fmt } (fmt = format.ts fns bound to receiptLang). Export from src/i18n/index.ts.

src/utils/receiptTemplate.ts: add exports ReceiptDocType ('receipt'|'tax_short'|'tax_full'), receiptDocTitle(type, lang), receiptDateTime(d, lang) via translate(lang,'receipt.dateTimeValue',{date: formatDate, time: formatTime}), receiptPayMethod(methods, lang) joined ' + ' via payMethodLabel, receiptCashier(name, lang), receiptFooter(cfgFooter, lang), receiptBranch(cfgBranch, lang) (default-or-empty -> translated). Change makeSampleData(config, lang: Language = config.receiptLanguage ?? 'th') per §5.2 (docTitle tax_short, dateTime of new Date(2024,0,1,10,30), payMethod cash, cashier receipt.sampleCashier, footerText/shopBranch through receiptFooter/receiptBranch; item names stay Thai). Do NOT change ReceiptRenderData, resolveField*, buildTemplateHtml, layoutElement, money(), or text-element handling. Import i18n modules directly (translate/format/labels/types), not i18n/index.

Create src/utils/posReceiptData.ts: export PosPrintInvoice (the current inline invoice type of printReceipt80mm in src/screens/web/WebPOSScreen.tsx ~:383 plus optional issuedAt?: number and payMethods?: {id: string; label?: string}[]), ShopFallbacks ({shopName, shopBranch, ...whatever the print block falls back to today}), and buildPosReceiptData(invoice, billType: ReceiptDocType, cfg: ReceiptConfig, fallbacks): ReceiptRenderData — a faithful port of the data-building part of printReceipt80mm (through the `data: ReceiptRenderData` literal) with rl = cfg.receiptLanguage ?? 'th': docTitle receiptDocTitle, dateTime issuedAt ? receiptDateTime : translate(rl,'receipt.dateTimeValue',{date: invoice.date, time: invoice.time}), payMethod payMethods ? receiptPayMethod : invoice.payMethod, cashier receiptCashier, footerText receiptFooter(cfg.footerText ?? '', rl), shopBranch receiptBranch(cfg.shopBranch || fallbacks.shopBranch, rl). Do not edit WebPOSScreen in this FEAT.

Create src/utils/taxInvoiceHtml.ts: export TaxInvoiceHtmlArgs (shop, buyer, items, totals, date values that the buildHTML closure in src/screens/sale/TaxInvoiceScreen.tsx :71-116 reads) and buildTaxInvoiceHtml(args, lang): string — port of that closure using translate(lang,'receipt.*'), receiptDateTime / formatDate, formatMoney(…, lang). Add any missing receipt.* keys to th + en. Do not edit TaxInvoiceScreen in this FEAT.

src/utils/memberTypeBenefits.ts: memberTypeDiscountLabel(type, lang: Language = 'th') -> translate(lang,'payment.memberTypeDiscount',{name, percent}) (th output identical to today). src/engine/adapter/cartAdapter.ts: BuildCalculationArgs (~:50) gains lang?: Language; synthetic promo/member-type names use it (default 'th'). Keep these modules pure (no store/react-native imports).

Tests: extend src/utils/__tests__/receiptTemplate.test.ts with design §10 cases (a) ui en + receipt th -> HTML contains ใบกำกับภาษีอย่างย่อ, 2567, เงินสด, ' น.', พนักงาน A, ขอบคุณที่ใช้บริการ; (b) ui th + receipt en -> Abbreviated Tax Invoice, 01/01/2024, Cash, Staff A, Thank you, Head Office and none of ใบกำกับภาษีอย่างย่อ/เงินสด/2567/' น.'/พนักงาน A/ขอบคุณที่ใช้บริการ/สำนักงานใหญ่; (c) text element verbatim both; (d) th DEFAULT output unchanged except sample dateTime '01/01/2567 10:30 น.' and empty footer -> thank-you. New src/utils/__tests__/posReceiptData.test.ts (RN+AsyncStorage mocks) covering every row of design §10 incl. the makeSampleData vs buildPosReceiptData parity for th and en. New src/utils/__tests__/taxInvoiceHtml.test.ts. Extend src/store/__tests__/receiptStore.migration.test.ts: change the pass-through test (~:171) to migrate(blob, 3) toBe(blob); add v2 -> 'th', v1 -> template + 'th', existing 'en' kept, merge garbage -> 'th', DEFAULT footer/branch === DEFAULT_FOOTER_TH/DEFAULT_BRANCH_TH. Extend src/utils/__tests__/memberTypeBenefits.test.ts with an en case (name untranslated).

Commit 9620371. Verification: lint = 13 baseline errors (none in touched files); npm test = 301 pass (259 prior + 42 new) + the 3 known suite-load failures; no screen/forbidden file touched.
SIGNATURES (for FEAT-004/005):
- src/utils/posReceiptData.ts: interface PosPrintInvoice { billNo: string; date: string; time: string; cashier: string; payMethod: string; items: { name: string; qty: number; unitPrice: number; disc: number; total: number }[]; subtotal: number; discount: number; vat: number; grand: number; status: string; cancelReason?: string; buyerInfo?: { name: string; addr: string; taxId: string; branch: string }; memberInfo?: { name: string; memberNo: string; pointBalance: number; walletBalance: number; pointsEarned?: number }; issuedAt?: number; payMethods?: { id: string; label?: string }[] }. interface ShopFallbacks { shopName: string; shopAddr: string; shopTel: string; shopTaxId: string; shopBranch: string; posRegNo: string } (pass SHOP_NAME/SHOP_ADDR/SHOP_TEL/SHOP_TAX_ID/SHOP_BRANCH/POS_REG_NO). buildPosReceiptData(invoice: PosPrintInvoice, billType: ReceiptDocType, cfg: ReceiptConfig, fallbacks: ShopFallbacks): ReceiptRenderData — faithful port incl. preVat/vat from grand, showLogo ?? true; dateTime uses issuedAt != null. printReceipt80mm in FEAT-004 should become: const data = buildPosReceiptData(invoice, billType, useReceiptStore.getState().config, {..SHOP_*}); then buildTemplateHtml(cfg.template ?? DEFAULT_TEMPLATE, data) + window open as before; its inline invoice type can be replaced by PosPrintInvoice.
- src/utils/taxInvoiceHtml.ts (PURE, no store import): interface TaxInvoiceHtmlArgs { invoiceNo: string; issuedAt: DateInput; seller: { name: string; address: string; taxId: string }; buyer: { name: string; taxId: string; address: string } (empty -> '-'); items: { name: string; qty: number; unitPrice: number; amount: number }[]; totals: { base: number; vat: number; grand: number }; vatRate?: number (default 7) }. buildTaxInvoiceHtml(args: TaxInvoiceHtmlArgs, lang: Language): string. TaxInvoiceScreen mapping: invoiceNo=`TAX${saleNo}`, issuedAt=sale.createdAt, seller={name: sellerName, address: sellerAddress, taxId: sellerTaxId}, buyer={name: buyerName, taxId: buyerTaxId, address: buyerAddress}, items=sale.items.map(i=>({name:i.product.name, qty:i.qty, unitPrice:i.unitPrice, amount:i.subtotal})), totals={base, vat, grand: grandTotal}. Output escapes user text; date now 'dd/MM/yyyy(BE) HH:mm น.' via receipt.dateTimeValue (was toLocale th-TH).

'th'). NOTE receiptTemplate imports receiptStore at runtime (tests need RN+AsyncStorage mocks).

- memberTypeDiscountLabel(type, lang: Language = 'th'); BuildCalculationArgs.lang?: Language (used for synthetic member-type promo name).
